Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: I took masters courses as they were the only ones available in english for my study field

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: I thought the quality was a bit worse, and the fact that they had attendance made it stressful. But overall the quality was fine.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Forest Management and Planning, Agricultural Water Management

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: While i did enjoy the courses, i would not recomend them to future exchange students, as the semester strucutre in the courses i had was not very well suited for exchange students, and it was very stressfull in the end of the stay.

What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: A lot of activities, i primarily participated in the ESN events.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: The ESN events to meet other exchange students

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Explore the surrounding cities as train tickets are cheap and transportation is easy.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: It was easy to talk to people as the italians are very friendly, but you have to get used to a culture that is not as punctual and organized

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Be yourself and just try to talk with them

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: They are not as well organized and the day schedule is generally shifted two hours forward

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The friendly people, the food, and a great city for being outside and doing things

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Do all practical things as soon as possible, respond to mails the day they arrive, and be prepared that even if you do the practical things in good time you will still have issues and it will be stressfull.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Look at the time schedule on the website and find out if the courses you want to take overlap, and when the exams are.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Meeting new people in a new setting and making international friends

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Getting the learning agreement signed and having to do practical things every week

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
